game_20260217_223017_g8:11.description: At 2 life against an opponent at 16 life with a 4/3 Enduring Curiosity on board, copying Oblivious Bookworm gives a ground 4/4 with incremental card draw. Deep-Cavern Bat would give a 4/4 with flying (can block Enduring Curiosity) and lifelink (desperately needed at 2 life), plus hand disruption against the opponent's 7-card hand.

game_20260217_223017_g8:7.description: Chose to copy Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man, which results in a vanilla 4/4 body (the ETB abilities won't trigger since {G}{G}/{U}{U} wasn't spent to cast Spider-Man). Copying Oblivious Bookworm would have given the same 4/4 body but with repeatable end-step card draw, which is extremely valuable given the player's near-empty hand (only Terror of the Peaks and Requiting Hex).

game_20260219_091818_g6:43.description: Cast Young Wolf before playing a land drop. With 1 untapped Forest and 1 land drop remaining, playing a land first (Wooded Foothills → fetch, or Forest) would give 2 mana, enabling alternatives like Badgermole Cub or Young Wolf + Walking Ballista (X=0, which dies and goes to graveyard as a future Soul Cauldron exile target for the ping ability - a key combo piece with Yawgmoth). By casting Young Wolf first, they lose the option to make a more impactful play this turn.

game_20260219_091818_g7:27.description: Playing Ba Sing Se (nonbasic) instead of Forest (basic) when both enter untapped and produce the same mana. Against an R/W opponent who could have Magmatic Hellkite (which destroys nonbasic lands), playing the basic Forest is safer. Additionally, the player already has a Ba Sing Se on the battlefield, so having more basics provides better protection for future nonbasic lands.

game_20260226_003306_g4:14.description: Played Boseiju, Who Endures instead of Eldrazi Temple. Both enable casting Glaring Fleshraker this turn, but Eldrazi Temple provides significantly more value in an Eldrazi deck by offering {C}{C} for future Eldrazi spells like Kozilek's Command, while Boseiju's Channel ability is wasted when played as a land early.

game_20260226_003306_g4:3.description: Bottomed Hollow One when the hand contains Burning Inquiry, which enables a free Hollow One on turn 1. With Burning Inquiry discarding 3 cards, Hollow One's cost is reduced by 6, making it free. This allows a turn 1 4/4 alongside Marauding Mako getting +1/+1 counters from the discards. Removing Hollow One eliminates the deck's most explosive opening.

game_20260226_003306_g4:6.description: Chose Walking Ballista over Eldrazi Temple from Devourer of Destiny's look-at-top-4 ability. With a hand that already has Ugin's Labyrinth and one Eldrazi Temple, putting a second Eldrazi Temple on top would guarantee the turn 3 land drop and provide additional Eldrazi mana acceleration. The deck is mana-hungry with Kozilek's Command and Devourer of Destiny in hand.

game_20260228_010846_g4:4.description: Bottomed Hunter's Insight instead of a redundant Island. The remaining hand of Chilling Trap, Crashing Tide, Forest, Island, Island, Island has 4 lands and only 2 spells - a very land-heavy 6-card hand. Keeping Hunter's Insight and bottoming a third Island would give a 3-land, 3-spell hand with better card quality and still adequate mana.

game_20260228_172012_g4:1.description: Mulliganed a keepable 2-land hand that had a 1-drop (Infantry Veteran) and 2-drop (Daybreak Charger) with a combat trick. While land-light, the hand has early plays and two draw steps to find a third land before needing it.

game_20260228_233444_g4:42.description: Casting Domesticated Hydra uses all mana for a single 3/3, when casting Fertilid (2G) + Dragon Fodder (1R) would deploy three creatures (2/2 + two 1/1s) and set up Volley Veteran next turn to deal 3 damage ETB (counting itself as a Goblin). Fertilid also provides ramp for future turns.

game_20260303_163336_g4:78.description: Failed to block Stalking Drone (2/2) with Basri's Acolyte (2/3 lifelink). The block would kill the Drone, keep the Acolyte alive as a 2/1, and gain 2 life from lifelink. The opponent cannot pump the Drone with +1/+2 because they have no source of colorless mana untapped. Instead, GPT52 took 2 damage unnecessarily and left the Drone alive.
